baseline.conditions: Dedicated Stonewake descent and pressure/air checks; 1,920 m vertical change. No Burrow connection.

title: A descent into someone else’s home
daily_life: Stonewake’s descent reaches Lumen Tide, an independent community with its own long history. Travelers become guests, not discoverers of an unclaimed world.
timing: The 16 km route changes elevation by 1,920 m from Stonewake z=320 to Lumen Tide z=-1600. Its two-day plan includes pressure and air checks; 16 km is not a straight vertical shaft.
handoff: At the descent house, agree equipment, visitor limits, return arrangements and the scope of any chart sharing. No descendant of this route opens below Burrow defenses.
story_option: A visitor reads a blank chart margin as an empty coast. A local inhabitant recognizes a protected shore whose omission was intentional.
production: Regional plan and elevation profile are separate views. Do not draw a uniform shaft gradient: segment-by-segment construction is not defined by the two endpoint elevations.
direction: Listed a-to-b planning reference; reverse passage requires a fresh itinerary.
geometry: Regional endpoints and route length inherited; connecting line is not a surveyed track.
